capabilities: Create and edit .ipynb notebooks with Code, Markdown, and Raw cells
Run Python cells in a shared local kernel with outputs, timing, and interrupts
Select or create Python environments and install, uninstall, or check packages
Integrate notebook properties, tags, and links with backlinks, search, graph, and Dataview
Export notebooks as .ipynb, HTML, Markdown, or Python files
extras: Desktop-only; mobile viewing belongs to earlier versions. Standalone Python installation verified only on macOS Apple Silicon; Windows and Linux are untested on physical devices. Remote Jupyter servers are not supported. Migration from the older obsidian-ipynb plugin requires manual steps and never enabling both at once.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or execute .ipynb files, so running Python next to notes requires leaving the vault for Jupyter or VS Code.

relations.evidence: After saving, the properties can be queried by an enabled Dataview plugin.
Back up the old obsidian-ipynb directory and disable it before installing the new plugin.

summary: Notebook editor that opens, edits, and runs native .ipynb files with local Python kernels, environment and package management, and Obsidian link integration.
